production.scope_ja: 原典SKILLと実入力PNGを読み、復元用build.mjsと要素対応表を執筆。実行と検査はCodexが担当。

applied_rules: Provided bitmap input reconstructed as one editable slide
Original visible labels and directed topology preserved
Simple example: native ownership for all meaning-bearing objects; its INSETS is empty. Supplementary complex example has one explicitly raster-owned synthetic inset.
One source-pixel-to-slide transform and original directed connector helpers
not_claimed: mathematical formulas or empirical experiment-photo reconstruction
preview_pipeline: PowerPoint PDF export → Poppler pdftoppm PNG, 1600px width
approximation_note_ja: 箱の塗り色は入力よりわずかに灰色寄りの近似です。原典の優先順位に従い、意味・ラベル・矢印の方向・編集性を保っています。画素単位の一致や見た目の改善を示す例ではありません。
current_codex_repair_scope: Current R13: self-contained saved pass04 handoff, corrected current/historical scope, complex main evidence. Original engine/checker and simple pass01 unchanged. Python arrow helper and R12 evidence retained as history.

supplementary_complex_example.current_refinement_scope: Current self-contained packaging of saved pass04; native/XML/media and actual PP/LO appearance equal to R12 accepted corner/arrow refinement. This is not a new reconstruction from the input.

distribution_replay_scope: source/distribution-replay.json is the earlier archive execution record; current rebuilt archives require their own execution evidence.
current_archive_replay_scope: Both separately extracted archive payloads, 4 saved builds, 8 PP/LO RGB comparisons and 2 complex native edit save/reopen comparisons; final metadata/documentation-only repack bound separately.
